name: Four Seasons Hotel Houston
insider_take: This downtown Houston gem sits just blocks from where the city was founded in 1836, offering luxury with a front-row seat to Space City's evolution.
whats_special: The hotel occupies floors 30-49 of a sleek downtown tower, putting you above the urban energy while the rooftop pool offers stunning views of the Houston skyline. You're walking distance to the historic Market Square Park, where Houston's Allen brothers first established their frontier trading post.
pro_tip: Book a city-view room on the higher floors for unobstructed views of the Medical Center and NASA Johnson Space Center in the distance—perfect for watching SpaceX launches from your window.
dont_miss: The underground tunnel system connects directly to the hotel, giving you climate-controlled access to 95+ city blocks of shopping and dining—a hidden network that most tourists never discover.
pros: Prime downtown location near major attractions and business district
Exceptional Four Seasons service standards and attention to detail
Sophisticated dining options and rooftop experiences
cons: Urban setting with limited green space
